subject: Exec step-back: OKR tactical reset, scope tightening, and dependency asks
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Exec step-back: OKR tactical reset, scope tightening, and dependency asks

Team —

Quick check-in ahead of Wednesday's leadership sync. I ran a short pulse across the 3 priority OKRs we need to tie to QBR outcomes and there are a few tactical decisions required this week to keep momentum without blowing runway. High-level: we need to tighten scope on Dedicated GA, reallocate one infra engineer for KV-cache optimization, and accelerate compliance artifacts for BrightWave (procurement wants SOC-lite evidence by 10/22).

Status snapshot (short):
- OKR A: API throughput (tokens/sec + latency): green — scheduled micro-optimizations, backlog clear.
- OKR B: Redwood Dedicated (GA target Oct->Nov): yellow/red — integration tests failing on certificate rotation and SOC artifacts incomplete.
- OKR C: Cost-per-inference (optimizer work): yellow — quantization tests show 18% savings but needs a 2-week spike to validate across our top-3 models.

Decisions/asks (need clear owners + dates):
1) Scope-tighten Dedicated GA to deliver core routing + billing only for GA; postpone advanced autoscale rules to post-GA. Need leadership signoff by EOD Tue (10/13). Owner: Vanessa?
2) Reassign 1 FTE (infra) to the KV-cache kernel work for 8 weeks starting 10/19. This is the single highest ROI for throughput/cost. Owner: Jonas to confirm capacity by 10/14.
3) Compliance pack: finalize privacy checklist + logs export to satisfy BrightWave procurement by 10/22. Naomi — can you own artifact completion?
4) Approve a 2-week scoped spike for quantization validation (cost OKR). Budget: up to $6k cloud spend. Decision by 10/13.

Attachments: Q4_okr_checkpoint_deck_v2.pdf (summary slides), dependency_tracker.xlsx (live tracker). Link to the deck and tracker in the related_links field.

If we can land (1) and (2) this week, we can keep the Dedicated GA target to early November without adding headcount. Otherwise we should plan a targeted GA delay + customer communications.

Proposed next steps:
- Vanessa: quick reply with scope preference (narrow GA or full GA with delay)
- Jonas: confirm resource swap availability by 10/14
- Naomi: confirm compliance artifacts you can deliver by 10/22 and what you need from security/CSE
- I will update the tracker and draft the customer-facing note to BrightWave if we need to slip timelines.

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Q4_okr_checkpoint_deck_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.4MB)]
[Attachment: dependency_tracker.xlsx (Excel, 240KB)]
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec step-back: OKR tactical reset, scope tightening, and dependency asks

Jordan — thanks for the concise callout. I agree we should narrow GA scope to the "routing + billing" baseline for launch and move advanced autoscale / policy-driven fallbacks to the post-GA backlog. Approve that scope-tighten.

On people: I can authorize a temporary reallocation of 1 senior infra engineer for 8 weeks (starting 10/19) to focus on KV-cache kernel and perf regressions, provided Jonas confirms there are no immediate OS-migration conflicts. Jonas — need your confirmation by 10/14 so we can notify the manager and update payroll.

On the quantization spike: approve up to $6k cloud spend for a focused 2-week validation. Naomi — if the compliance artifacts are clean we should be able to keep BrightWave engaged for a soft GA.

I'll take responsibility for the customer communication if we decide to narrow GA but continue a tight rollout. Jordan, draft the message for my review.

Vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
VP, GTM & Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec step-back: OKR tactical reset, scope tightening, and dependency asks

Confirming capacity: I can free up Thomas R. (senior infra) for the KV-cache/ kernel work starting 10/19 for 8 weeks. We have one scheduled maintenance window the week of 10/26 for the region migration — Thomas will need three contiguous days off that week, but I will compensate by shifting two midweek sprints.

Notes on impact: with Thomas on the KV work we should see measurable latency improvement on the 2048-token path within 3-4 days of the spike, and sustained 12–15% per-token cost reduction after full integration and a second validation pass. I'll update the dependency_tracker.xlsx with Thomas' timeline and the blocked items he needs (test keys, staging capacity).

Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: dependency_tracker.xlsx (updated)]
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 11:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec step-back: OKR tactical reset, scope tightening, and dependency asks

Happy to own the compliance pack for BrightWave. Quick realities / asks from security:
- I can deliver the privacy-compliance-checklist.pdf, audit-log export instructions, and a brief runbook by 10/20 if I get the requested logs from SRE and a confirmation of retention windows (14 vs 30 days).
- Need a short sign-off from Legal for the SOC-lite language by 10/18 — can someone nudge Legal?

I'll add the artifact list to the tracker and attach the checklist draft to this thread. If BrightWave procurement needs anything else (specific syslogs, export samples), we should surface that ASAP.

Naomi

--
Naomi Feldman
Head of Product Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: privacy-compliance-checklist.pdf (PDF, 210KB)]
From: Erin Lawson <erin.lawson@brightwavehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Exec step-back: OKR tactical reset, scope tightening, and dependency asks

Thanks for the transparency — helpful to see the proposed tradeoffs. From procurement's side: BrightWave can proceed with a GA that excludes advanced autoscaling so long as the compliance artifacts are in place by 10/22 and we get a short runbook for incident handling. We have an internal approval window that closes 10/29 for initial purchase; shipping the compliance pack on 10/20 gives us time to move.

If you anticipate the GA slipping beyond 11/05, please flag that now so we can re-align our internal rollout.

— Erin Lawson
Director, Procurement
BrightWave Health
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Erin Lawson <erin.lawson@brightwavehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Oct 2026 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec step-back: OKR tactical reset, scope tightening, and dependency asks

Appreciate the quick replies and confirmations. Summary / next steps I'll action now:
- Scope: Narrowed GA to routing + billing (Vanessa signoff) — implementing.
- Resource: Jonas confirms Thomas R. starts 10/19 for 8 weeks — I will update HR/manager.
- Compliance: Naomi delivering artifacts by 10/20; Legal nudge required for SOC language (Evelyn — can you loop Legal?).
- Quantization spike: approved up to $6k — engineering to spin up on 10/19.
- Customer comms: drafting and will send to Vanessa for sign-off by EOD Wed (10/13).

I'll attach the updated tracker and the communication draft in the Drive link, and open a DocuSign for the initial purchase terms once Naomi confirms artifact completion.

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
